issues.description: Dead NewRateLimit call whose stats are immediately overwritten on the next line.
issues.detail: In the value_to_metric override branch, NewRateLimit(...) is invoked (which registers a stats struct via statsManager.NewStats(rateLimit.FullKey)), then rateLimit.Stats is immediately replaced with NewStats(enhancedKey). The first allocation is discarded — wasted work and a stray metric registration per GetLimit call. Delete the NewRateLimit reconstruction.

issues.description: Three near-identical key-building branches that collapse to one rule.
issues.detail: The matchedViaWildcard, matchedUsingValue, and default-key branches all reduce to: write entry.Key, then if (valueToMetric || matchedUsingValue) and entry.Value != "" append _value. Collapse into a single appendSegment helper expressing the invariant once. This removes ~25 lines of incidental complexity and makes the rule legible.

issues.description: FullKey comparison guard is unreliable because FullKey is not consistently populated upstream.
issues.detail: The guard `if enhancedKey != rateLimit.FullKey` depends on FullKey being set on the non-detailed_metric path, but it is only assigned in the DetailedMetric branch. The override therefore fires accidentally or relies on an undocumented cross-function invariant. Either always override deliberately or compare against the actual existing stats key.

issues.description: valueToMetricFullKey builder runs on every GetLimit call even when no descriptor uses the flag.
issues.detail: GetLimit is a hot path. The new strings.Builder allocates and appends unconditionally, paying cost for every deployment that never enables value_to_metric. Track at config-load time whether any descriptor in the tree sets valueToMetric and skip the builder when false. No benchmark accompanies the change.

issues.description: rateLimitDescriptor switched to positional struct literal — fragile across future field additions.
issues.detail: Calls now read `&rateLimitDescriptor{map[...]{}, rateLimit, nil, descriptorConfig.ValueToMetric}`. Adding a field silently risks misassignment at every call site. Use named fields (descriptors:, limit:, wildcardKeys:, valueToMetric:) — costs nothing, prevents a real class of bug.

issues.description: Feature semantically overlaps detailed_metric and is resolved by precedence rather than decomposition.
issues.detail: value_to_metric and detailed_metric both answer 'include the runtime value in the metric.' Two booleans plus a precedence rule complect two concepts that could be one enum (none|leaf|path) or a per-descriptor flag on detailed_metric. Worth a maintainer conversation before landing a second parallel codepath that will likely grow a third flag.

synthesis.summary: The panel converges on NEEDS-WORK. Three concrete defects dominate: a dead NewRateLimit allocation whose stats are immediately discarded, a FullKey comparison guard that relies on an undocumented and inconsistently-held invariant, and three near-identical key-building branches that collapse to a single rule. Secondary concerns are hot-path cost paid by deployments that don't use the flag, a fragile positional struct literal, and unresolved semantic overlap with detailed_metric. The feature is reasonable; the implementation needs consolidation and one real bug fix before merge.
